artifacts.note: Native pin built from the same tree as the published wasm; the wasm itself was not executed by this campaign.

image_supplements.source: reference/image-supplements-20261012 (26 tail cases), installed locally per case with scripts/install_image_supplements.py

reference_provenance.server_access: read-only: rsync pulls of per-case small files and captures; remote hashing by attestation scripts; no prefix/, 102h.exe or DATs copied.

simulation96.scope: run_port_references.py --require-matrix (direct --replay entry): exact original replay states/terminals and five object pools at predefined checkpoints; invulnerability declared on both sides per input-provenance.

audio_requests96.scope: Ordered sound/music requests and fades during replay frames1..original terminal, plus the first stage-entry music request. Scene transitions after the terminal and physical output PCM are separate probes.

criteria.rule: a checkpoint passes only when every region is within tolerance

images96.separation: Image verdicts are separate from simulation96/audio_requests96. The capture pass also re-ran a complete-reference simulation through natural Replay-menu entry; its per-case verdict is reported as capture_pass_simulation_passed and is not merged into simulation96.
images96.method: run_capture_matrix.py could not be given --require-matrix because its preflight needs all 96 cases' original BMPs present at once (~5.6 GB + supplements). It was run once per case with --complete-reference --original-attestation (same capture/compare code, same criteria), streaming one case's BMPs at a time and deleting pixels after the compact metrics were kept; per-case matrix receipts are aggregated here.
